songs.title: Tuingie Kwa Yahweh Bwana
songs.lyrics:
Tuingie! {Tuingie kwa Yahweh Bwana, furaha gani siku ya leo}*2

1. Nalifurahi waliponiambia, twende nyumbani kwa Yahweh Bwana
2. Bwana asema nyumba yangu hii leo, itaitwa nyumba ya sala
3. Tumwabudu Bwana Yesu Kristu, atupa uzima wa milele
4. Tufurahie siku hii ya leo, kwani ni siku yake Bwana
5. Sasa miguu yetu isimame, katika hekalu lake Bwana
6. Tumshukuru Bwana Yesu Kristu, atupa uzima wa milele

songs.title: Tukipenda Wenzetu
songs.lyrics:
Tukipenda wenzetu, kati yetu Mungu yupo *2
1. Aliyetufanya tuwe ndugu ndiye Yesu ndugu yetu
Chuki yote na hasira, kati yetu ziondoke
2. Tukimpenda Mungu wetu, tuanzie na nduguze
Audhiye mmoja wao, mapendoye si ya kweli
3. Tuwe moyo mmoja, roho moja, tuwe pia kundi moja
Tupendane kama vile Yesu alivyotuvyotupenda
4. Furahini nyote binadamu, mwimbieni Mungu wenu
Amri yake ni nyepesi, neno lake kupendana
5. Kati ya ugomvi na fitina, na katika kisirani
This Sunday the Choir Family prays with Godfrey Mutuli for his intentions and Choir intentions, thank you, Mutuli, for the songs selections!
Mungu wetu hapapendi, Mungu wetu wa amani
6. Yesu Kiongozi wetu mwema, amri yako twaijua
Washa nyoyo za wakristu wapendane siku zote

songs.title: Tukiria Mugate (Meru)
songs.lyrics:
Tukiria mugate juju itu, Mwathani, na tukinyua gikombe giki,
tugatumiria gukua gwaku, {mwanka riria ukeeja} x3
(Translation: When we eat this bread, and drink this blood, we proclaim your death Oh Lord, till you come again.)

songs.title: Tumaini Letu Ni Kwa Bwana
songs.lyrics:
Tumaini letu ni kwa Bwana,
Kwa maana ana uwezo wa milele.

1. Tutamsifu Bwana siku zote…
Kwa maana ana uwezo wa milele.
2. Yeye ndiye mwanzo wa uzima..
3. Yeye ndiye aliyetuumba…
4. Vitu vyote vimeumbwa naye…
5. Yeye ndiye kiongozi wetu…
6. Tumwabudu, tumsifu daima...
7. Sifa na uwezo viwe kwake…

songs.title: Tumsifu Maria
songs.lyrics:
1. Tumsifu Maria, enyi wanae, tutoe salamu, tumshangilie
Salaam, salaam, salaam Maria *2
2. Nyota ya bahari, mlango wa mbingu; Mwondoa hatari, mama wa Mungu
3. Maria Bikira, ndiwe mteule; Umechaguliwa tangu milele
4. Hakuna mwombaji aombaye; Kwa Kristu Mwokozi kuliko wewe
5. Mametu mbinguni tumshangilie; Mwanao mpenzi pamoja nawe

songs.title: Tunaomba Amani
songs.lyrics: 1. Amani | 2. Upendo | 3. Baraka | 4. Neema | 5. Fadhili

songs.title: Tupeane Amani
songs.lyrics: 1. Amani | 2. Upendo | 3. Baraka | 4. Neema

songs.title: Tusimame Ndugu (Beba Mikononi)
songs.lyrics:
1. Tusimame ndugu twende kwake Bwana (kweli)
Usisite ndugu amka twende hima
Beba mikononi (mwako) uliyojaliwa
Peleka kwa Bwana, upate Baraka *2
2. Peleka kwa moyo, moyo wa mapendo (kweli)
Peleka kwa Bwana uliyojaliwa
3. Sadaka ya fedha, fedha za mifuko (ndugu)
Amka upeleke mezani kwa Bwana
4. Mavuno mifugo, ni mali ya Bwana (kweli)
Tupeleke kwake atazipokea
5. Mkate divai tupeleke kwake (leo)
Tupate baraka mbele zake Bwana
6. Twende ndugu twende, mbele zake Bwana (twende)
Tupeleke nafsi zetu kwake Bwana

songs.title: Tutakiane Amani Eh
songs.lyrics: 1. Amani | 2. Upendo | 3. Fadhili | 4. Baraka | 5. Neema |

songs.title: Twende Nyumbani Mwa Bwana
songs.lyrics:
1. Nalifurahi waliponiambia twende nyumbani mwa Bwana *4
Wololololo!
Twende nyumbani twende (twende) nyumbani
Njooni (twende) tuingie nyumbani mwake Bwana Mungu.
Inapendeza!
Twende nyumbani twende (twende) nyumbani
Njooni (twende) tuingie nyumbani mwake Bwana Mungu.
2. Nyumba ya Mungu ya kuabudiwa njooni tukamuabudu. *2
Nyumba ya Mungu inayopendeza kweli imejaa Baraka. *2
3. Nyumba ya Mungu ni yenye amani pia ni yenye upendo *2
Tufurahie nyumbani ya Mungu kwani ni yenye furaha *2
4. Tucheze ngoma kinanda kinubi, gita kayamba na zeze *2
Tumuimbie anayestahili kwani ni Mungu milele. *2

songs.title: Twende Nyumbani Mwa Bwana Hoya! (Hoya!)
songs.lyrics:
Twende nyumbani mwa Bwana, Hoya!
Twende nyumbani mwa Bwana, Hoya! *2
Tuimbe tushangilie tupige vigelegele tupige
makofi hoya hoya! *2

1. Twende tumsifu kwa nyimbo za Zaburi wakristue hoya -
Tumsujudie twende tukamwabudu wakristu hoya
2. Twende tumsifu kwa ngoma na kayamba wakristu, hoya -Tumsujudie ...
3. Twende tukacheze vinanda na vinubi wakristu, hoya -Tumsujudie ...
4. Tujitayarishe kwa nyimbo zake Bwana wakristu, hoya -Tumsujudie ...

songs.title: Twende Sote Nyumbani Mwake
songs.lyrics:
Twende sote nyumbani mwake Bwana Mungu (Aee-ee)
Twende sote nyumbani mwake aliyetuumba x2

1. Yeye ndiye kinga yetu Bwana Mungu (aee-ee)
...Twende sote nyumbani mwake aliyetuumba
Yeye ndiye nguvu yetu Bwana Mungu ...
2. Wewe Bwana wa Majeshi Bwana Mungu...
Ndiye Mungu wa Yakobo Bwana Mungu...
3. Wewe Mfalme wa wafalme Bwana Mungu..
Ndiye Mfalme wa dunia Bwana Mungu...
4. Ndiye Mfalme wa Mbinguni Bwana Mungu...
Wewe Mungu wa wokovu Bwana Mungu...
5. Wewe Ndiwe Mwamba wetu Bwana Mungu...
Na hekima ya dunia Bwana Mungu...
6. Jina lako litukuzwe Bwana Mungu...
Ndiye Mungu Mtakatifu Bwana Mungu...
7. Pendo lake la milele Bwana Mungu...
Ndiye Mungu Mwana kweli Bwana Mungu...

songs.title: Twende Wote
songs.lyrics:
{Twende wote tukatoe sadaka kwa Bwana, twendeni
Twende wote tukatoe sadaka kwa Bwana } *2
{Twende, twende tukatoe *2
Twende wote tukatoe sadaka kwa Bwana } *2
1. Tukatoe mkate, kiini cha ngano,
Twende tukatoe sadaka kwa Bwana
2. Tukatoe divai tunda la mzabibu,
3. Tukatoe mazao ya mashamba yetu,
4. Nayo maisha yetu anayatakasa,
5. Navyo tulivyo navyo ndiye atupaye,

songs.title: Twendeni Kwa Karamu
songs.lyrics:
1. Twendeni kwa karamu ya Bwana tumeitwa -
Twendeni twende kumpokea
(Ni mwaliko wa Bwana - Tukale mkate wa uzima) *2
2. Tujitakase mbele ya kwenda kwa karamu hii
- Twende watakatifu -
3. Karibu kwangu Yesu ukae kwangu daima
- Nifunze njia yako -
4. Na kwa uwezo wako imani yangu nakiri
- We u Mungu Mwokozi -
5. Usituache basi pamoja nasi ukae
- Kwa kuwa kumekucha –
6. Na tufurahi mwisho pamwe na Baba milele
- Kwa umoja na Roho –

songs.title: Uipokee
songs.lyrics:
Uipokee sadaka, Ee Bwana Mungu tusikie,
Bwana uipokee kwa wema, Ee Bwana Munguu wetu *2

1. Twakutolea sadaka ya ibada yetu, ikupendeze itupatie wokovu.
2. Ee Bwana usikilize sala zetu, tunazokutolea Bwana Mungu wetu.
3. Ututakase kwa nguvu ya sadaka hii, natupate maondoleo ya dhambi zetu.
4. Ni nani aliye Mungu ila wewe Bwana, na utukuzwe Mungu wa wokovu wetu

songs.title: Uipokee Sadaka
songs.lyrics:
Uipokee sadaka, Ee Bwana Mungu tusikie (Bwana)
Uipokee kwa wema, Ee Bwana Mungu wetu *2

1. Twakutolea sadaka ya ibada yetu, ikupendeze itupatie wokovu.
2. Ee Bwana usikilize sala zetu, tunazokutolea Bwana Mungu wetu.
3. Ututakase kwa nguvu ya sadaka hii, natupate maondoleo ya dhambi zetu.
4. Ni nani aliye Mungu ila wewe Bwana, na utukuzwe Mungu wa wokovu wetu

songs.title: Uje, Roho Mtakatifu
songs.lyrics:
Uje Roho Mtakatifu, tuangaze toka mbingu
Roho zetu kwa mwangao
Uje Baba wa maskini, uje mtoa wa vipaji
Uje mwanga wa mioyo
Ee Mfariji mwema sana, ee rafiki mwa(a)nana
Ewe raha mustarehe
Kwenye kazi u pumziko, kwenye joto, burudisho
U mfutaji wa machozi
Ewe mwanga wenye heri, uwajaze waamini
Neema yako mioyoni
Bila nguvu yako wewe, mwanadamu hana kitu
Kwake yote yana kosa
Osha machafuko yetu, panyeshee pakavu petu
Na kuponya majeraha
Ulegeze ukaidi, pasha moto ubaridi
Nyosha upotevu wote
Wape waamini wako, wenye tumaini kwako
Paji zako zote saba
Wape tuzo ya fadhila, wape mwisho bila ila,
Wape heri ya milele
Amina aleluya, amina, aleluya,
Amina, aleluya

songs.title: Umsihi Mwanao
songs.lyrics:
Umsihi mwanao Yesu, Maria;
Asamehe makosa yangu
Anitoe mashaka yote Maria;
Yalio mu-moyoni mwangu
(Maria) Maria unisaidie, (Maria) uniombee;
Mimi mwanao mwenye dhambi

1. Nionee huruma mama, mimi niliye mpotevu
Mwili wangu ni dhaifu kwa sababu ya dhambi zangu
2. Na magonjwa niponye mama, kwa jina la mwanao Yesu
Naye Roho mtakatifu, Aimarishe nguvu zangu

ADORATION:

songs.title: Uniondolee Dhambi Nitakase
songs.lyrics:
Uniondolee dhambi, nitakase,
Unioshe niwe mweupe pe *2

1. Nakiri makosa yangu, naziona dhambi zangu,
Unioshe niwe mweupe pe.
2. Mimi kweli mkosefu, tangu kuzaliwa kwangu,
Mwenye dhambi tangu tumboni mwa mama yangu
3. Hivyo unafanya vyema, wewe unaponihukumu,
Una haki unaponiadhibu
4. Wewe wataka unyofu, ule unyofu wa ndani,
Nifundishe hekima moyoni
5. Niumbie moyo safi, na uweke ndani yangu,
Roho mpya iliyo thabiti.

songs.title: Unirehemu
songs.lyrics:
1. Nitalisifu nilihimidi jina lako Mungu Mkuu.
Nitalitunza nilisujudu kwa wema wako ule mkuu

Unirehemu unitakase mwisho nifike kwako mbinguni.
Unirehemu unitakase mwisho nifike kwako enzini.

Nitalisifu nilihimidi . . .
2. Umeyalinda maisha yangu, nayo maovu kaniepusha.
Umenilinda nyumbani mwangu, Baraka zako kwangu ni tele.
3. Kwenye mabonde hata milima kaniongoza m-chunga wangu.
Kwenye mashaka na hofu nyingi kaniepusha we ngome yangu.
4. Nizidishie fadhili zako, kazini mwangu unijalie.
Unifundishe uniwezeshe, nishukuru kwa sala zangu.
5. Unijalie rehema zako, nitende wema kwa ndugu zangu.
Chuki hasira pia ugomvi, niondolee niwe mpole.
6. Tukufu kwako ee Mungu Baba, Mwana na Roho Mtakatifu.
Ni wewe Alpha pia Omega, mwanzo na mwisho hata milele.

songs.title: Unirehemu Unitakase
songs.lyrics:
1. Nitalisifu nilihimidi jina lako Mungu Mkuu.
Nitalitunza nilisujudu kwa wema wako ule mkuu
Unirehemu unitakase mwisho
nifike kwako mbinguni.
Nitalisifu nilihimidi . . .
2. Umeyalinda maisha yangu, nayo maovu kaniepusha.
Umenilinda nyumbani mwangu, Baraka zako kwangu ni tele.
Ave, ave verum corpus
natum de Maria Virgine,
Vere passum immolatum
in Cruce pro homine,
Cujus latus perforatum
unda* fluxit (et)* sanguine,
Esto nobis praegustatum
in mortis examine.
Translation:
Hail, true body born of the Virgin Mary,
Who truly suffered,
sacrificed on the Cross for man,
Whose pierced side overflowed with
water* and blood,
Be for us a foretaste**
In the test of death.
This Sunday the Choir Family prays with Jane Wairimu for her intentions and Choir intentions; thank you, Jane, for the songs selections!
3. Kwenye mabonde hata milima kaniongoza m-chunga wangu.
Kwenye mashaka na hofu nyingi kaniepusha we ngome yangu.
4. Nizidishie fadhili zako, kazini mwangu unijalie.
Unifundishe uniwezeshe, nishukuru kwa sala zangu.
5. Unijalie rehema zako, nitende wema kwa ndugu zangu.
Chuki hasira pia ugomvi, niondolee niwe mpole.
6. Tukufu kwako ee Mungu Baba, Mwana na Roho Mtakatifu.
Ni wewe Alpha pia Omega, mwanzo na mwisho hata milele.

songs.title: Upokee Sadaka Yetu
songs.lyrics:
1. Upokee sadaka yetu, twakutolea Baba
Upokee navyo vipaji, twakutolea Baba

Pokea Baba zawadi *2 twakutolea Baba

2. Upokee mkate wetu -
Upokee divai yetu
3. Upokee mazao yetu-
Upokee na fedha zetu -
4. Nasi pia ni mali yako -
Tunatubu makosa yetu -
5. Upokee mioyo yetu -
Upokee na nafsi zetu -
6. Haya yote ni mali yako-
Uyapokee kwa huruma -
7. Uviunge vipaji vyetu -
Na sadaka yake mwanao -
8. Usifiwe ewe mtukufu -
Kwa sadaka yake na yetu -
9. Utuhurumie wakosefu -
Tuletee baraka yako –

songs.title: Usia wa Maria
songs.lyrics:
Sisi wana dunia tukumbuke maneno, aliyosema Bikira Maria
Alipowatokea watoto wa Fatima, Lucia Francisi na Yasinta

Alisema tusali, tusali rosari, tupate amani
Na tuwaombee wale wakosefu wasio na mwombezi
Na wasiomwamini Yesu Mwokozi wamuamini ili waokoke

1. Mama yetu anahuzunishwa sana, kwa matendo yetu maovu
Anajua adhabu yetu ijayo, hivyo anaona huruma sana
2. Atusihi tuache dhambi kwa dhati, tuache kumkosea Yesu
Tuyatubu makosa yetu yote, ili Bwana atupatie amani
3. Tusitende maovu na dhambi, atusihi mama wa Yesu,
Tusimkasirishe tena Mungu, asije tutupa motoni milele
4. Ibada ya moyo safi wa Maria, tuizingatie daima.
Tuipokee komunyo Takatifu kila juma mosi ya kwanza ya mwezi.

songs.title: Usifiwe Utatu Mtakatifu
songs.lyrics:
Usifiwe Utatu mtakatifu, na Umoja usiogawanyika
na Umoja usiogawanyika.

1. Sisi tutatukuza kwa sababu umetufanyizia huruma Yake.
2. Ee Bwana Mungu wetu jinsi gani jinalo la ajabu duniani
3. Vinywani mwa watoto wanyonyao umeiweka misingi ya nguvu.

songs.title: Utujie Masiya Wetu
songs.lyrics:
Utujie, Masiya wetu.

1. Wakungojao hawatafadhaika - Masiya wetu.
2. Unayeketi juu ya Kerubini -
3. Amsha uwezo wako uje-
4. Dondokeni enyi mbingu toka juu -

songs.title: Utukuzwe Ewe Baba Mungu Utukuzwe
songs.lyrics:
1. Utukuzwe ewe Baba Mungu utukuzwe - Aleluya
Kwani Yesu mfufuka ametualika – Aleluya
Utukuzwe – Utukuzwe, Baba muumba ulimwengu – aleluya *2
This Sunday the Choir Family prays with the Choir Leadership for their intentions and Choir intentions; thank you Team for the work you do in His
Vineyard!
2. Tumepokea mkate, mazao ya mashamba -
Ndiyo alama kwetu, ya wema wako mkuu—
3. Ni tunda la bidii, ya mkono na ya moyo—
Jalie iwe kwetu, chakula cha uzima—
4. Zawadi ya divai, kutoka mizabibu—
Ndiyo alama kwetu, ya wema wako mkuu—
5. Ni tunda la bidii, ya mkono na ya moyo—
Jalie iwe kwetu, kinywaji cha kiroho—
6. Sifa kwako ee Mungu, kwa kuotesha mkate—
Shukrani kwako Baba, kwa kutulisha sisi—
7. Utukuzwe, Ee Mungu, uliyetuchagua -
Tuwe taifa lako na kukutumikia

songs.title: Vamuvamba
songs.lyrics:
Ni litsulisa liu mwami weru Yesu lwa yavambwa;
Lwa Yuda vatsama Yesu vamuvamba vamuvamba
Navutswa khandi khwasoma ivanjeli gahandikwa;
Uvwoni vweru vwajira vamuvamba vamuvamba

Lwa ndali muheyi ndamuvamba}* 2
Yesu ndamuvamba, Yesu ndamuvamba *2

Mumasakhi gege Yesu, khwasamewa myoyo gyeru
Mumasakhi gege Yesu khwahonyinywa mioyo gyeru

Yesu khwamuvamba *4

songs.lyrics:
1. Vanga Yohana vasaina
Yee Aleluya vanga Yohana vasaina

songs.title: Wakristu Wote Tusimame
songs.lyrics:
1. Wakristu wote tusimame, tutangaze
Injili yake Bwana wetu, iende mbele *2
Iende mbele, Injilli, iende mbele
‘njili ya Yesu - injili, iende mbele *2
2. Watawa wote
3. Vijana wote
This Sunday the Choir Family prays with Benson Mburu for his intentions and Choir intentions, thank you, Benson, for the songs selections!
4. Watoto wote
5. Mapadre wote

songs.title: Walipomsulubisha
songs.lyrics:
1. Walipomuua Yesu walidhani wameshinda
Kumbe badala yake injili yaenda mbele
Injili yaenda mbele, injili yaenda mbele,
Kumbe badala yake injili yaenda mbele *2
2. Walipomsulubisha walidhani . . .
3. Walipomtema mate walidhani . . .
4. Walipomnywesha siki walidhani . . .

songs.title: Watu Wote Watangazieni
songs.lyrics:
1. Watu wote watangazieni neno la Muumba Mungu,
wamwamini na kutubu yote *2

Wambieni (waambieni) watu wote leo
Wamwamini (wamwamini) Bwana Yesu kweli
Nakushika (na kushika) neno lake Bwana
Nakuomba (na kuomba) kwa Muumba Mungu *2

2. Wale wote tuliomwamini Bwana atakaporudi,
tutakwenda naye juu mbinguni
3. Watu wote wasiomwamini Bwana atakaporudi,
watalia na shetani nao.
4. Ndugu zetu tuliomwamini Bwana tutakapokwenda,
duniani moto utawaka

songs.title: Watumishi Wake Baba
songs.lyrics:
1. Watumishi wake Baba wangapi waliopo;
Wanakula na kusaza chakula chake Baba
Nami nataabika hapa; Nashiriki na nguruwe
Chakula kisichofaa, yanipasa kurudi
Nitarudi na kusema; Baba yangu nisamehe
Nimekosa kwake Mungu, na mbele yako Baba
2. Baba kamwona yu mbali kashikwa na huruma;
Akakimbia kumlaki kamkumbata na busu.
3. Baba sistahili tena kuitwa mwana wako;
Unifanye kama mmoja wa watumishi wako.
4. Baba yangu nimekosa ninaomba huruma;
Unisamehe nirudi nikakutumikie.
5. Nasongea ninakuja ninakukimbilia;
Mimi ni mtoto mpotevu Baba unipokee.

songs.title: We Are One in the Spirit
songs.lyrics:
1. We are One in The Spirit, We are One in The Lord.
We are One in The Spirit, We are One in The Lord.
And we pray that all unity may one day be restored.
And they'll know we are Christians by our love, By our Love,
Yes they'll know we are Christians by our love.
2. We will work with each other, We will work side by side.
We will work with each other, We will work side by side.
And we'll guard each man's dignity And save each man's pride.
3. We will walk with each other, We will walk hand in hand.
We will walk with each other, We will walk hand in hand.
And together we'll spread the News that God is in our land.

songs.title: We Asa Osa
songs.lyrics:
{We Asa! We Asa osa nthembo yaitu,
We Asa osa na uituathima} *2
1. {Na Mukate wumite nganuni ya nthi, ...We Asa osa na uituathima } *2
2. Na ndivai yumite nzavivuni . . .
3. Na mbesa syumite mivukoni . . .
4. Na ngetha yumite miundani . . .
5. Na malondu maumite ndithyani yitu . . .

songs.title: We Bring the Sacrifice of Praise
songs.lyrics:
1. We bring the sacrifice of praise / Into the house of the Lord
We bring the sacrifice of praise / Into the house of the Lord
And we offer up to You / The sacrifices of thanksgiving
And we offer up to You / The sacrifices of joy

2. We bring the sacrifice of love
3. We bring the sacrifice of joy
4. We bring the sacrifice of peace

songs.title: We Gather Together
songs.lyrics:
We gather each day in The Father’s love
We gather with Jesus His Son
We gather in faith with the Spirit of God
We gather together as one
1. We offer our peace, we offer our love
We offer the good deeds we’ve done
Bread blessed and broken for all to share
When we gather together as one
2. When we proclaim the Good News of God
We pray for the old and the young
We share in the gift of the lamb of God
When we gather together as one
3. There are no borders, no distance too great
No matter where we come from
We are all neighbors, wherever we live
When we gather together as one
4. We raise our hearts, we celebrate
The family of God we’ve become
The spirit unites us, in joy and in faith
When we gather together as one

songs.title: WE PRAISE YOU (Gloria) — by Bukenya Herman (Christus Rex Ecclesia, Kampala)
songs.lyrics:
Glory to God in the highest
(Refrain) We praise you, we adore you, we glorify,
We give you thanks. We give you thanks.

1a. And on earth peace to men, peace to men who are God's friends.
1b. God Almighty Father, heavenly King, we praise you and we bless you.

2a. We adore you, we glorify you, we give you thanks for your great glory.
2b. Lord Jesus Christ, only Son of the Father, Lord, Lamb of God, Jesus Christ.

3a. You take away the sins of the world, have mercy, receive our prayer.
3b. You are seated at the right hand of the Father, have mercy, Lord Jesus Christ.

4a. You alone are Holy, you alone are Lord, you alone are most high.
4b. Glory to the Father, glory to the Son, to the Spirit now and evermore.
Amen, Amen, Amen.

songs.title: Were You There?
songs.lyrics:
1. Were you there, when they crucified my Lord (were you there?)
Were you there, when they crucified my Lord.
Oh! sometimes, it causes me, to tremble, tremble, tremble,
Were you there when they crucified my Lord.
2. Were you there, when they nailed him to the tree (were you there?)
Were you there, when they nailed him to the tree.
Oh! sometimes, it causes me, to tremble, tremble, tremble,
Were you there when they nailed him to the tree.
This Sunday the Choir Family prays with Dr. Florence Mukii for her intentions and Choir intentions; thank you, Florence, for the songs selections!
3. Were you there, when they pierced him in the side (were you there?)
Were you there, when they pierced him in the side.
Oh! sometimes, it causes me, to tremble, tremble, tremble,
Were you there when they pierced Him in the side.
4. Were you there, when the sun refused to shine (were you there?)
Were you there, when the sun refused to shine.
Oh! sometimes, it causes me, to tremble, tremble, tremble,
Were you there when the sun refused to shine.
5. Were you there, when they laid him in the tomb (were you there?)
Were you there, when they laid him in the tomb?
Oh! sometimes, it causes me, to tremble, tremble, tremble,
Were you there when they laid him in the tomb.

songs.title: What a Friend We Have in Jesus
songs.lyrics:
1. What a friend we have in Jesus, all our sins and griefs to bear!
What a privilege to carry everything to God in prayer!
O what peace we often forfeit, O what needless pain we bear,
All because we do not carry everything to God in prayer!
2. Have we trials and temptations? Is there trouble anywhere?
We should never be discouraged; take it to the Lord in prayer!
Can we find a friend so faithful who will all our sorrows share?
Jesus knows our every weakness; take it to the Lord in prayer!
This Sunday the Choir Family prays with Gloria Muthumbi for her intentions and Choir intentions; thank you, Gloria, for the songs selections!
3. Are we weak and heavy laden, cumbered with a load of care?
Precious Savior, still our refuge; take it to the Lord in prayer!
Do thy friends despise, forsake thee? Take it to the Lord in prayer!
In his arms he'll take and shield thee; thou will find a solace there.

songs.title: What Returns to Yahweh
songs.lyrics:
1. What returns to Yahweh can I make *2
For blessings of every kind from Him that I have received

What returns to Yahweh, what returns can I make *2
What returns to Yahweh? For blessings of every kind
From Him that I have received

2. He created me the Lord, He adopted me the Lord.
For blessings ...
3. He purifies me, strengthens me, by the Spirit the Spirit’s power,
For blessings ...

songs.title: What Shall I Offer
songs.lyrics:
{What shall I offer to the Lord to make Him happy (oh tell me)
What shall I offer to the Lord to please Him} *2
1. {I may give Him the best of my clothes He may not take it.
I may give Him the best of my shoes He may not take it} *2
{A loving heart (He will love), a patient heart (He will love)
A humble heart (He will love), a caring heart He will love} *2
2. {I may give Him a gift of a ram He may not take it
I may give Him a gift of a cow He may not take it} *2
{A loving heart (He will love), a patient heart (He will love)
A humble heart (He will love), a caring heart He will love} *2
3. I may give Him a gift of a car He may not take it
I may give Him a gift of a house He may not take it
{A loving heart (He will love), a patient heart (He will love)
A humble heart (He will love), a caring heart He will love} *2

songs.title: Whatsoever You Do
songs.lyrics:
Whatsoever you do to the least of My Brothers,
That you do unto Me.

1. When I was hungry you gave me to eat.
When I was thirsty you gave me to drink.
Now enter into the Home of my Father.
2. When I was homeless you opened your door.
When I was naked you gave Me your coat.
Now enter into the Home of my Father.
3. When I was weary you helped me find rest.
When I was anxious you calmed all my fears.
Now enter into the Home of my Father.
4. When in a prison you came to My cell.
When on a sick bed you cared for My needs.
Now enter into the Home of my Father.
5. When I was aged you bothered to smile.
When I was restless you listened and cared.
Now enter into the Home of my Father.
6. When I was laughed at you stood by My side.
When I was happy you shared in My joy.
Now enter into the Home of my Father.

songs.title: When I Survey
songs.lyrics:
1. When I survey the wondrous cross
On which the Prince of glory died,
My richest gain I count but loss,
And pour contempt on all my pride.
2. Forbid it, Lord, that I should boast,
Save in the death of Christ my God!
All the vain things that charm me most,
I sacrifice them to His blood.
3. See from His head, His hands, His feet,
Sorrow and love flow mingled down!
Did e’er such love and sorrow meet?
Or thorns compose so rich a crown?
4. Were the whole realm of nature mine?
That were an offering far too small;
Love so amazing, so divine,
Demands my soul, my life, my all.

songs.title: Wonderful Merciful Saviour
songs.lyrics:
1. Wonderful, merciful Savior
Precious Redeemer and Friend
Who would have thought that a Lamb
Could rescue the souls of men
Oh, You rescue the souls of men

You are the One that we praise
You are the One we adore
You give the healing and grace
Our hearts always hunger for
Oh, our hearts always hunger for

2. Counselor, Comforter, Keeper
Spirit we long to embrace
You offer hope when our hearts have
Hopelessly lost the way
Oh, we hopelessly lost the way
3. Almighty, infinite Father
Faithfully loving Your own
Here in our weakness You find us
Falling before Your throne
Oh, we're falling before Your throne

songs.title: Wonderful Words of Life
songs.lyrics:
1. Sing them over again to me, Wonderful words of Life;
Let me more of their beauty see, Wonderful words of Life.
Words of life and beauty teach me faith and duty.
Beautiful words, wonderful words, Wonderful words of Life. *2
2. Christ, the blessed One, gives to all Wonderful words of Life;
Sinner, list’ to the loving call, Wonderful words of Life.
All so freely given, wooing us to heaven.
3. Sweetly echo the Gospel call, Wonderful words of Life;
Offer pardon and peace to all, Wonderful words of Life.
Jesus, only Savior, sanctify forever.

songs.lyrics:

Kinatushibisha Yesu asante
2. Kila tunapokula mkate huu,
Tunapata uzima wa milele
3. Kila tunapokunywa kikombe hiki,

songs.lyrics:
1. Yesu alanga, Yesu alanga vana vave.
Oh Yesu yenyanga vosi muitse khuye.
Yesu alanga, Yesu alanga vana vave
2. Yesu yevulwa, yesu yevulwa Bethlehemu

Mimi ni kipofu ni mauti (mimi ni mauti)

Upindo wa nguo (nguo yako nzuri)
{Uniguse moyo, moyoni mwangu, Nitaimba sifa sifa zako} *2

Twende huko nchi ya mbali, ya Kanaani ndiko tutaishi milele
{Fimbo yake Musa ilituokoa
Fimbo yake Musa, ilituongoza
{Nchi ile ya Misri (nchi ya Farao) Tulimwona Bwana mwenye enzi} *2
This Sunday the Choir Family prays with Louise Raura for her intentions and Choir intentions, thank you, Louise, for the songs selections!

songs.lyrics:

Wakiwa mbali wakamwita: Mwalimu Yesu ‘tuhurmie

Yesu Mnazareti ‘tuhurumie.
Yesu mwenye huruma akawaponya *2

2. Wakati wote Mwokozi Yesu, Alipopita huku na huko,
Aliwakuta walemewao, Na kwa huruma akawaponya.
3. Na hata sasa Yesus aweza, kuja kwetu tunapomwita,
Kutuokoa toka dhamini, Na kuwa naye huko mbinguni.

songs.title: Yesu Mwema Najitolea Kwako
songs.lyrics:
1. Yesu mwema najitolea kwako kwa leo hii na siku zote,
This Sunday the Choir Family prays with Mrs. Cynthia Obala for her intentions and Choir intentions; thank you, Cynthia, for the songs selections!
Nafsi yangu na moyo wangu wote.
(Heri kweli *3 raha ya uwingu) *2
2. Ndani yangu umekuja daima; kuwa nami ni pendo lako.
Ewe mpenzi mwenye utamu mwingi.
(Ni mapendo *3 ya moyo wako) *2
3. Nitaweza kukurudishia nini, kwa wema huu na pendo lako?
Roho yangu umeifadhilia.
(Nikupende *3 ni tamaa yangu) *2
4. Weka Rabii katika roho yangu wema wako na unyenyekevu,
na pendo kuu fadhili ya imani.
(Niongoze *3 katika imani) *2

songs.title: Zaeni Matunda Mema
songs.lyrics:
1. Zaeni matunda mema, zaeni matunda yale
Zaeni yenye baraka, zaeni ya heri

Bwana akiyapokea, yatabarikiwa vyema
Zaeni matunda mema, zaeni ya heri

2. Safisha mwenendo wako, safisha matendo yako
Safisha na Bwana Yesu, safisha yote
3. Fanyeni kazi kindugu, fanyeni kazi kwa bidi
Fanyeni na Bwana Yesu fanyeni na yote
4. Tolea matendo yako pamoja na moyo wako,
Naye Bwana Mungu wako atakubariki
5. Baraka za Mungu Baba, baraka za Mungu mwana
Na za Roho Mtakatifu ziwe nanyi nyote

KATONDA WAFFE OYO NNAMWEBAZA NTYA (This Our God — How Shall I Thank Him?)

Katonda waffe oyo – Nnamwebaza ntya? (×3)
Olw'ebirungi enfaafa by'atuwadde?
Nga tweyanze! Katumuddize kw'ebyo by'atuwadde
Ebivudde mu kutegana okwa buli nkya
(Ssebo ow'ekisa, ebyaffe bisiime
Anti biraga omutima ogusiima) (×2)
Ogw'abaana bo
This our God — how shall I thank Him? (×3)
For the abundant good things He has given?
How grateful we are! Let us give back to Him from what He has given
that which comes from our daily toil each morning
(Merciful Lord, accept these things of ours
for they show a grateful heart) (×2)
The heart of your children

1. Laba omugaati, laba n'eviini gye tuleese
Laba n'amakula g'otuwadde tugaleeta
Tobigaana, bitono nyo, biraga Kitaffe
Bwe tusiima Taata by'otuwadde, webalege
Behold the bread, behold too the wine we have brought
behold too the produce you have given, which we bring
Do not reject them, small though they are, they show, our Father
how thankful we are; Father, for what you have given, we thank you greatly

2. Tunaakuwa ki, ddala ky'osiima, nannyini nsi?
Laba n'obulamu bw'otuwadde tubuleeta
Tobigaana...

What can we give you that truly pleases you, O Owner of the earth?
Behold too the life you have given us — we bring it
Do not reject them... (refrain repeats)
3. Ebintu by'ensi, tubiwe Ddunda atwagala nnyo
Tumuwe ebilala by'atuwadde olw'ekisa kye
Tobigaana...
The things of the world — let us give them to the Provider who loves us so
Let us give Him other fruits He has given, out of His mercy
Do not reject them... (refrain repeats)
4. Nnaakuddiza ki, ddala eky'ebbeeyi ekikugyamu?
Kino kye nsobola kye nkuwadde onokitwala
Tobigaana...
The things of the world — let us give them to the Provider who loves us so
Let us give Him other fruits He has given, out of His mercy
Do not reject them... (refrain repeats)
